reviewBeforeUse: These are drafts for an operator to personalize and send manually. StayXI does not currently send guest emails. Replace every bracketed field with property-approved details, or remove that line. Do not promise a response time or service that the operator has not confirmed.

welcomeEmail.subject: Your stay at [PROPERTY_NAME] — arrival information
welcomeEmail.body:
Hello [GUEST_NAME],

We look forward to welcoming you to [PROPERTY_NAME].

Arrival: [HOST_APPROVED_CHECK_IN_TIME_AND_INSTRUCTIONS]
Guest text line: [CONFIRMED_GUEST_TEXT_NUMBER_AND_HOURS]

Please use the contact details in your booking confirmation for urgent or safety concerns. For immediate danger, call 911.

Your host,
[HOST_OR_OPERATOR_NAME]

checkoutReminderEmail.subject: Checkout information for [PROPERTY_NAME]
checkoutReminderEmail.body:
Hello [GUEST_NAME],

Your host-approved checkout time is [CHECKOUT_TIME].

Before leaving: [HOST_APPROVED_CHECKOUT_STEPS]

If you have a question, use [CONFIRMED_HOST_CONTACT_METHOD].

Thank you,
[HOST_OR_OPERATOR_NAME]

emergencyContactEmail.subject: Contact information for your stay at [PROPERTY_NAME]
emergencyContactEmail.body:
Hello [GUEST_NAME],

For urgent property concerns, contact [CONFIRMED_HOST_OR_OPERATOR_CONTACT]. StayXI is not an emergency service and does not guarantee a human response. If anyone is in immediate danger, call 911.

[HOST_OR_OPERATOR_NAME]

specialRequestEmail.subject: We received your request about [PROPERTY_NAME]
specialRequestEmail.body:
Hello [GUEST_NAME],

We received your request: [REQUEST_DETAILS]. This message confirms receipt only; it does not confirm that the request can be accommodated. We will contact you using [CONFIRMED_CONTACT_METHOD] if we can confirm it.

[HOST_OR_OPERATOR_NAME]

feedbackRequestEmail.subject: Feedback about your stay at [PROPERTY_NAME]
feedbackRequestEmail.body:
Hello [GUEST_NAME],

Thank you for staying at [PROPERTY_NAME]. If you would like to share feedback, reply using [CONFIRMED_CONTACT_METHOD].

[HOST_OR_OPERATOR_NAME]
